title: Angleton as OSS man in Italy

tellings.quote: made it clear to me that um James Jesus Angleton was the US like OSS person involved in Italy at the time.

plain: A man named James Jesus Angleton was, so the story goes, the American intelligence officer working in Italy in the 1940s for the OSS, the United States' wartime spy service. Michels passes this on from a woman named Pippa Malmgren, who he says made it clear to him that Angleton was the US OSS person involved in Italy at the time. If true, it would put Angleton at the centre of American secret work in postwar Italy.
